Smoke Testing আর Sanity Testing — দুটো নামই "quick check" বোঝায়। Junior QA অনেক সময় confuse হয় — "smoke আর sanity same thing না?" না, উদ্দেশ্য আলাদা, timing আলাদা, coverage আলাদা। Wrong time-এ wrong test = time waste।

এই post-এ দুটো concept step by step explain করা হয়েছে — real example, checklist, regression-এর সাথে relation, এবং Agile sprint-এ কখন কোনটা run করবেন।

---

এক লাইনে পার্থক্য

  • Smoke Testing: "Build টা কি চালু যোগ্য?" — broad, shallow, whole app
  • Sanity Testing: "এই specific fix কি কাজ করেছে?" — narrow, deep, changed area only

Building Analogy:

Smoke Test = building-এ ঢোকার আগে দেখা — light জলে? door open হয়? stairs ঠিক? Sanity Test = plumber fix-এর পর শুধু bathroom check — tap leak আছে কিনা। পুরো building inspect (regression) তার পর।

---

Smoke Testing — বিস্তারিত

কী?

Smoke Testing (Build Verification Test / Build Acceptance Test) হলো নতুন build receive করার পর first quick check — application crash করে কিনা, critical path কাজ করে কিনা। Name hardware testing থেকে — machine on করলে smoke বের হয়? serious problem আছে কিনা।

কখন করবেন?

  • Dev team নতুন build QA-তে handover করার পর — প্রথম কাজ
  • CI/CD pipeline-এ automated smoke suite
  • Production deploy-এর immediately after (post-deploy smoke)
  • Environment change (new server, DB migration) পর

Smoke Fail হলে কী হয়?

Build reject — full regression start করা হয় না। Dev team-কে return: "Build not testable — login crash." Time save — broken build-এ 500 test case run করার meaning নেই।

Typical Smoke Test Checklist — Web Application

  • Application launch — no crash, homepage loads
  • Login page accessible
  • Valid credentials login success
  • Main dashboard/home visible after login
  • Primary navigation works (1–2 key menu items)
  • Logout works
  • Critical API health — /api/health returns 200

Time: 15–30 minutes manual, 5–10 minutes automated

Smoke Test Checklist — E-Commerce Example

  • Homepage product list loads
  • Product detail page opens
  • Add to cart works
  • Checkout page loads (payment optional in smoke)
  • User login/register page accessible

Smoke Test Characteristics

  • Wide coverage — major features touch, depth shallow
  • Documented — fixed checklist, repeatable
  • Automated preferred — CI pipeline-এ run
  • Non-exhaustive — edge cases নয়, happy path only
---

Sanity Testing — বিস্তারিত

কী?

Sanity Testing হলো specific bug fix বা small change deploy-এর পর changed area quickly verify — fix actually কাজ করছে কিনা, related feature break হয়নি তো। Narrow scope, targeted depth।

কখন করবেন?

  • Bug fix verify — developer "BUG-089 fixed" বললে
  • Small feature tweak — one screen change
  • Hotfix production-এ deploy-এর পর
  • Regression-এর আগে quick confidence check on fix

Real Sanity Test Example

Bug: Password reset email not sending (BUG-089)

Fix deployed. Sanity test steps:

  1. Forgot password page open — loads correctly
  2. Registered email enter — submit request
  3. Email received within 2 minutes
  4. Reset link click — password reset page opens
  5. New password set — success message
  6. Login with new password — works

Result: Sanity Pass → proceed to full regression on auth module

Another Sanity Example — Payment Fix

Bug: bKash payment timeout after 30 seconds

Sanity scope:

  • bKash payment complete within acceptable time
  • Order status PAID after success
  • Confirmation SMS/email sent
  • Other payment methods (card) — quick check not broken

Sanity Test Characteristics

  • Narrow coverage — changed module only
  • Often ad-hoc — fix-specific, not always documented
  • Unscripted possible — experienced tester judgment
  • Fast — 10–20 minutes typically
---

Smoke vs Sanity vs Regression — Full Comparison

বিষয় Smoke Sanity Regression
উদ্দেশ্যBuild stable?Fix works?Nothing broken?
ScopeWhole app, shallowChanged area, deepFull/near-full app
কখনNew build arrivalAfter bug fixBefore release
Duration15–30 min10–20 minHours–days
Documented?Yes — checklistOften ad-hocYes — test suite
Automated?Highly recommendedSometimesPartial–full
Fail actionReject buildReopen bugBlock release
---

Typical QA Flow — কোন order-এ?

  1. Dev deploys new build to QA environment
  2. Smoke Test — pass? continue. Fail? reject build
  3. Feature testing / bug fixes during sprint
  4. Sanity Test — each critical fix verify
  5. Regression Test — full suite before release
  6. Production deploy
  7. Post-deploy Smoke — production live check

Sanity smoke-এর পরে নয় — smoke always first on new build। Sanity fix-specific, regression-এর আগে optional quick gate।

---

Decision Guide — আজ কোন test?

Smoke Test করুন যদি:

  • আজ প্রথম bar এই build open করছেন
  • CI pipeline new build trigger করেছে
  • Production-এ just deploy হয়েছে
  • Environment reset/migration হয়েছে

Sanity Test করুন যদি:

  • Specific bug fix verify করতে হবে
  • Developer "please check BUG-123" বলেছে
  • Hotfix deploy — narrow scope confirm
  • Full regression-এর আগে fix confidence চাই

Regression Test করুন যদি:

  • Release candidate sign-off
  • Major feature complete
  • Multiple fixes integrated — side effect check
---

Common Confusion & Mistakes

  • "Smoke = Sanity" — wrong. Smoke = whole build. Sanity = one fix.
  • Smoke test-এ edge cases — smoke shallow, edge case regression-এ
  • Smoke fail-এ regression start — waste time, reject build first
  • Sanity pass = release ready — sanity narrow, full regression still needed
  • No smoke checklist documented — inconsistent, tester dependency
  • Sanity too broad — whole app test naming it "sanity" — that's mini-regression
---

Automation Tips

Smoke Suite Automation

Best ROI — 5–10 automated tests CI-তে every build:

  • API health check
  • Login API success
  • Protected endpoint with token
  • Critical GET endpoints 200

Fail = pipeline red, QA notified, no manual smoke wait।

Sanity Automation

Fix-specific test case add করুন regression suite-এ — next time same area automated sanity। Bug fix-এর সাথে automated test = regression prevention।

---

Agile Sprint Example

Monday: Sprint build #42 deployed → Smoke (20 min) → Pass → feature testing start

Wednesday: BUG-089 password reset fixed → Sanity on auth (15 min) → Pass

Friday: Sprint end → Regression (4 hours) → Release decision

Friday PM: Production deploy → Post-deploy Smoke (10 min) → Done

Pro Tip:

Project-এ এক page Smoke Checklist document রাখুন — Confluence/Wiki। সব QA same list follow করবে। Sanity-র জন্য bug ticket-এ "Sanity Steps" section add করুন — fix verify repeatable।

---

পরিশেষে

Smoke আর Sanity দুটোই time-saver — wrong test avoid করে:

  • Smoke — broken build-এ deep testing avoid
  • Sanity — unfixed bug-এ full regression avoid
  • Regression — release confidence, side effect catch

মনে রাখুন: Smoke = "চালু যোগ্য?" Sanity = "fix ঠিক?" Regression = "কিছু ভাঙেনি?" — তিনটা layer, তিনটা purpose।

Tags: #SmokeTesting #SanityTesting #RegressionTesting #BuildVerification #BAT #QA #SQA #TestStrategy #AgileTesting
